newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's VSM plans to issue bonds in spring.
newsitem.headline: Russia's VSM plans to issue bonds in spring.

text.p: RAO Vysokoskorostnye Magistrali (VSM, or High-Speed Railways) plans to make a new issue of bonds in March or April, the company said on Monday.
"The third bond issue is planned for this March or April," VSM said in a statememt.

The state-owned company is raising funds to build a high-speed Moscow-St Petersburg rail link and has already issued 360 billion roubles of bonds which are traded on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange.
The securities are basically the same as Russian OFZ interest-bearing government bonds. OFZ bonds pay quarterly interest linked to current issues of GKO discount Treasury bills.
